articles.summary: Concludes 30-Year Tenure Leading Development of TPOXX®, the First FDA-Approved Antiviral for the Treatment of Smallpox NEW YORK, Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - SIGA Technologies (NASDAQ: SIGA), a commercial stage pharmaceutical company, announced today that Dennis Hruby, Ph.D., Executive Vice President and Chief Scientific Officer, will retire effective today, concluding more than 30 years with the Company. Dr. Hruby joined SIGA in 1996 as a senior scientific advisor, became Vice President of Research in 1997, and has served as Chief Scientific Officer since 2000. Over that period, he led the development of tecovirimat, now marketed as TPOXX ® , from early-stage research through U.S. FDA approval of the oral formulation in 2018 and the intravenous formulation in 2022, as well as regulatory approvals in Canada, the European Union, the United Kingdom and Japan. TPOXX was the first antiviral therapeutic approved for the treatment of smallpox and has been sold to more than 30 countries.
articles.title: SIGA Announces Retirement of Chief Scientific Officer Dennis Hruby, Ph.D.

articles.summary: Awarded $15 Million Procurement Contract from Canadian Department of National Defence for Oral TPOXX in October Corporate Update Conference Call Today at 4:30 PM ET NEW YORK, Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - SIGA Technologies, Inc. (SIGA) (Nasdaq: SIGA), a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company, today reported financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. “While we continue to work with the U.S. Government toward a new TPOXX procurement contract, our international business remains an important part of our strategy,” stated Diem Nguyen, Chief Executive Officer. “We recently announced a $15 million contract with the Canadian Department of National Defence, a longstanding customer, and are actively pursuing opportunities with other international governments to further diversify our customer base over time.” Summary Financial Results ($ in millions, except per share amounts) Three Months Ended September 30 Nine Months Ended
